<thought>Attempted to retrieve template ID 84231 but got None, indicating it may not be directly accessible. However, the mapped reaction SMARTS is known: "[O:1]=[N+;!H0:2]([O-:3])>>[NH2:2]". Since the tool apply_template requires a template ID, and we cannot obtain it, we cannot programmatically generate the precursors. Given the reaction, the retro‑transformation replaces an aromatic primary amine (–NH2) with a nitro group (–NO2). In the target molecule “CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1”, the aromatic amine is the “c2cc(N)cc3...” fragment. Replacing that –NH2 with –NO2 yields the precursor SMILES: “CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1”. The second product “O=S(=O)(O)c1ccccc1F” does not contain an amine, so no precursor from this template. Therefore the list of possible precursors is a single combination containing that nitro‑precursor.

<final_answer>[[\"CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1\"]]</final_answer>
